# Apply Fixes

## Change Summary

No code changes applied. The review (cr6) approved the implementation without amendments. All three amendments from the pending list were already applied and verified in the plan_and_implement stage of this completion round: (1) compute_co2_kla() refactored to return raw uncapped K_LA(CO2), with Euler cap moved to usage site matching the O2 path; (2) spawn_progress_accum resets added on zero-population early returns in spawning(); (3) hatch_success_carry resets added in egg_development() and clamp_berried_to_adults() when cohorts are cleared. All 115 targeted tests pass across 8 test suites, clippy and formatting are clean.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Confirmed review outcome is 'approved' with empty follow_up_or_amendments — no code fixes needed
2. [Completed] Ran cargo test for 8 test suites: co2_exchange (12), chemistry (21), concentration_helpers (11), dissolved_oxygen (5), save_load (27), validation (12), shrimp_population (19), shrimp_feeding_pathway (8) — all 115 passed
3. [Completed] Ran cargo clippy -p tank_core -- -D warnings: clean, exit 0
4. [Completed] Ran cargo fmt --check -p tank_core: clean, exit 0

## Validation Evidence

- cargo test --test co2_exchange: 12 passed, 0 failed
- cargo test --test chemistry: 21 passed, 0 failed
- cargo test --test concentration_helpers: 11 passed, 0 failed
- cargo test --test dissolved_oxygen: 5 passed, 0 failed
- cargo test --test save_load: 27 passed, 0 failed
- cargo test --test validation: 12 passed, 0 failed
- cargo test --test shrimp_population: 19 passed, 0 failed
- cargo test --test shrimp_feeding_pathway: 8 passed, 0 failed
- cargo clippy -p tank_core -- -D warnings: clean, exit 0
- cargo fmt --check -p tank_core: clean, exit 0
- Review outcome: approved with no amendments — all three pending amendments from prior review were applied and verified in the plan_and_implement stage

## Outstanding Risks

None identified.
